verses.original: וַֽיִּקְרְב֞וּ רָאשֵׁ֣י הָֽאָב֗וֹת לְמִשְׁפַּ֤חַת בְּנֵֽי־ גִלְעָד֙ בֶּן־ מָכִ֣יר בֶּן־ מְנַשֶּׁ֔ה מִֽמִּשְׁפְּחֹ֖ת בְּנֵ֣י יוֹסֵ֑ף וַֽיְדַבְּר֞וּ לִפְנֵ֤י מֹשֶׁה֙ וְלִפְנֵ֣י הַנְּשִׂאִ֔ים רָאשֵׁ֥י אָב֖וֹת לִבְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·rə·ḇū rā·šê hā·’ā·ḇō·wṯ lə·miš·pa·ḥaṯ bə·nê- ḡil·‘āḏ ben- mā·ḵîr ben- mə·naš·šeh mim·miš·pə·ḥōṯ bə·nê yō·w·sêp̄ way·ḏab·bə·rū lip̄·nê mō·šeh wə·lip̄·nê han·nə·śi·’îm rā·šê ’ā·ḇō·wṯ liḇ·nê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Now the family heads of the clan . . . of Gilead son of Machir son of Manasseh one of the clans . . . of Joseph approached Moses . . . and the leaders who were the heads . . . of the Israelite families and addressed them . . .
verses.literalPt: E CHEGARAM os chefes dos pais da família de Gileade, filho de Maquir, filho de Manassés, das famílias dos filhos de José, e falaram diante de Moisés, e diante dos príncipes, chefes dos pais dos filhos de Israel,

verses.original: וַיֹּאמְר֗וּ אֶת־ אֲדֹנִי֙ צִוָּ֣ה יְהוָ֔ה לָתֵ֨ת אֶת־ הָאָ֧רֶץ בְּנַחֲלָ֛ה בְּגוֹרָ֖ל לִבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַֽאדֹנִי֙ צֻוָּ֣ה בַֽיהוָ֔ה לָתֵ֗ת אֶֽת־ נַחֲלַ֛ת צְלָפְחָ֥ד אָחִ֖ינוּ לִבְנֹתָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mə·rū ’eṯ- ’ă·ḏō·nî ṣiw·wāh Yah·weh lā·ṯêṯ ’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ bə·na·ḥă·lāh bə·ḡō·w·rāl liḇ·nê yiś·rā·’êl wa·ḏō·nî ṣuw·wāh Yah·weh lā·ṯêṯ ’eṯ- na·ḥă·laṯ ṣə·lā·p̄ə·ḥāḏ ’ā·ḥî·nū liḇ·nō·ṯāw
verses.literal: saying When the LORD commanded my lord to give the land as an inheritance to the Israelites . . . by lot He also commanded him to give the inheritance of our brother Zelophehad to his daughters
verses.literalPt: E disseram: O SENHOR mandou a meu senhor que, por sorte, desse esta terra em herança aos filhos de Israel; e a meu senhor foi ordenado pelo SENHOR, que a herança do nosso irmão Zelofeade se desse às suas filhas.

verses.original: וְ֠הָיוּ לְאֶחָ֞ד מִבְּנֵ֨י שִׁבְטֵ֥י בְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֮ לְנָשִׁים֒ וְנִגְרְעָ֤ה נַחֲלָתָן֙ מִנַּחֲלַ֣ת אֲבֹתֵ֔ינוּ וְנוֹסַ֕ף עַ֚ל נַחֲלַ֣ת הַמַּטֶּ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר תִּהְיֶ֖ינָה לָהֶ֑ם וּמִגֹּרַ֥ל נַחֲלָתֵ֖נוּ יִגָּרֵֽעַ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yū lə·’e·ḥāḏ mib·bə·nê šiḇ·ṭê ḇə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl lə·nā·šîm wə·niḡ·rə·‘āh na·ḥă·lā·ṯān min·na·ḥă·laṯ ’ă·ḇō·ṯê·nū wə·nō·w·sap̄ ‘al na·ḥă·laṯ ham·maṭ·ṭeh ’ă·šer tih·ye·nāh lā·hem ū·mig·gō·ral na·ḥă·lā·ṯê·nū yig·gā·rê·a‘
verses.literal: But if they marry any of the men from the other tribes of Israel . . . their inheritance will be withdrawn from the portion of our fathers and added to the tribe into which they marry So our allotted inheritance would be taken away
verses.literalPt: E, casando-se elas com alguns dos filhos das outras tribos dos filhos de Israel, então a sua herança será diminuída da herança de nossos pais, e acrescentada à herança da tribo a que vierem a pertencer; assim se tirará da sorte da nossa herança.

verses.original: וְאִם־ יִהְיֶ֣ה הַיֹּבֵל֮ לִבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ וְנֽוֹסְפָה֙ נַחֲלָתָ֔ן עַ֚ל נַחֲלַ֣ת הַמַּטֶּ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר תִּהְיֶ֖ינָה לָהֶ֑ם וּמִֽנַּחֲלַת֙ מַטֵּ֣ה אֲבֹתֵ֔ינוּ יִגָּרַ֖ע נַחֲלָתָֽן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- yih·yeh hay·yō·ḇêl liḇ·nê yiś·rā·’êl wə·nō·ws·p̄āh na·ḥă·lā·ṯān ‘al na·ḥă·laṯ ham·maṭ·ṭeh ’ă·šer tih·ye·nāh lā·hem ū·min·na·ḥă·laṯ maṭ·ṭêh ’ă·ḇō·ṯê·nū yig·gā·ra‘ na·ḥă·lā·ṯān
verses.literal: And when the Jubilee for the Israelites . . . comes their inheritance will be added to the tribe into which they marry and taken away from the tribe of our fathers
verses.literalPt: Vindo também o ano do jubileu dos filhos de Israel, a sua herança será acrescentada à herança da tribo daqueles com que se casarem; assim a sua herança será tirada da herança da tribo de nossos pais.

verses.original: וַיְצַ֤ו מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶת־ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל עַל־ פִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה לֵאמֹ֑ר כֵּ֛ן מַטֵּ֥ה בְנֵֽי־ יוֹסֵ֖ף דֹּבְרִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·ṣaw mō·šeh ’eṯ- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl ‘al- pî Yah·weh lê·mōr kên maṭ·ṭêh ḇə·nê- yō·w·sêp̄ dō·ḇə·rîm
verses.literal: So at the word of the LORD Moses commanded the Israelites . . . . . . The tribe of the sons of Joseph speaks correctly
verses.literalPt: Então Moisés deu ordem aos filhos de Israel, segundo o mandado do SENHOR, dizendo: A tribo dos filhos de José fala o que é justo.

verses.original: זֶ֣ה הַדָּבָ֞ר אֲשֶׁר־ צִוָּ֣ה יְהוָ֗ה לִבְנ֤וֹת צְלָפְחָד֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר לַטּ֥וֹב בְּעֵינֵיהֶ֖ם תִּהְיֶ֣ינָה לְנָשִׁ֑ים אַ֗ךְ לְמִשְׁפַּ֛חַת מַטֵּ֥ה אֲבִיהֶ֖ם תִּהְיֶ֥ינָה לְנָשִֽׁים׃
verses.transliteration: zeh had·dā·ḇār ’ă·šer- ṣiw·wāh Yah·weh liḇ·nō·wṯ ṣə·lā·p̄ə·ḥāḏ lê·mōr laṭ·ṭō·wḇ bə·‘ê·nê·hem tih·ye·nāh lə·nā·šîm ’aḵ lə·miš·pa·ḥaṯ maṭ·ṭêh ’ă·ḇî·hem tih·ye·nāh lə·nā·šîm
verses.literal: This . . . is what the LORD has commanded concerning the daughters of Zelophehad They may marry . . . anyone they please . . . provided they marry . . . within a clan of the tribe of their father
verses.literalPt: Isto é o que o SENHOR mandou acerca das filhas de Zelofeade, dizendo: Sejam por mulheres a quem bem parecer aos seus olhos, contanto que se casem na família da tribo de seu pai.

verses.original: וְלֹֽא־ תִסֹּ֤ב נַחֲלָה֙ לִבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מִמַּטֶּ֖ה אֶל־ מַטֶּ֑ה כִּ֣י אִ֗ישׁ בְּנַחֲלַת֙ מַטֵּ֣ה אֲבֹתָ֔יו יִדְבְּק֖וּ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lō- ṯis·sōḇ na·ḥă·lāh liḇ·nê yiś·rā·’êl mim·maṭ·ṭeh ’el- maṭ·ṭeh kî ’îš bə·na·ḥă·laṯ maṭ·ṭêh ’ă·ḇō·ṯāw yiḏ·bə·qū bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: No inheritance in Israel . . . may be transferred from tribe to tribe because each of the Israelites is to retain the inheritance of the tribe of his fathers
verses.literalPt: Assim a herança dos filhos de Israel não passará de tribo em tribo; pois os filhos de Israel se chegarão cada um à herança da tribo de seus pais.

verses.original: וְכָל־ בַּ֞ת יֹרֶ֣שֶׁת נַחֲלָ֗ה מִמַּטּוֹת֮ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ לְאֶחָ֗ד מִמִּשְׁפַּ֛חַת מַטֵּ֥ה אָבִ֖יהָ תִּהְיֶ֣ה לְאִשָּׁ֑ה לְמַ֗עַן יִֽירְשׁוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אִ֖ישׁ נַחֲלַ֥ת אֲבֹתָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵāl baṯ yō·re·šeṯ na·ḥă·lāh mim·maṭ·ṭō·wṯ bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl lə·’e·ḥāḏ mim·miš·pa·ḥaṯ maṭ·ṭêh ’ā·ḇî·hā tih·yeh lə·’iš·šāh lə·ma·‘an yî·rə·šū bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl ’îš na·ḥă·laṯ ’ă·ḇō·ṯāw
verses.literal: Every daughter who possesses an inheritance from any Israelite . . . tribe must marry . . . within a clan of the tribe of her father so that every Israelite . . . will possess the inheritance of his fathers
verses.literalPt: E qualquer filha que herdar alguma herança das tribos dos filhos de Israel se casará com alguém da família da tribo de seu pai; para que os filhos de Israel possuam cada um a herança de seus pais.

verses.original: וְלֹֽא־ תִסֹּ֧ב נַחֲלָ֛ה מִמַּטֶּ֖ה לְמַטֶּ֣ה אַחֵ֑ר כִּי־ אִישׁ֙ בְּנַ֣חֲלָת֔וֹ יִדְבְּק֕וּ מַטּ֖וֹת בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lō- ṯis·sōḇ na·ḥă·lāh mim·maṭ·ṭeh lə·maṭ·ṭeh ’a·ḥêr kî- ’îš bə·na·ḥă·lā·ṯōw yiḏ·bə·qū maṭ·ṭō·wṯ bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: No inheritance may be transferred from one tribe to another for each tribe of Israel must retain its inheritance
verses.literalPt: Assim a herança não passará de uma tribo a outra; pois as tribos dos filhos de Israel se chegarão cada uma à sua herança.

verses.original: כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־ מֹשֶׁ֑ה כֵּ֥ן עָשׂ֖וּ בְּנ֥וֹת צְלָפְחָֽד׃
verses.transliteration: ka·’ă·šer ṣiw·wāh Yah·weh ’eṯ- mō·šeh kên ‘ā·śū bə·nō·wṯ ṣə·lā·p̄ə·ḥāḏ
verses.literal: So the daughters of Zelophehad did as the LORD had commanded Moses . . .
verses.literalPt: Como o SENHOR ordenara a Moisés, assim fizeram as filhas de Zelofeade.

verses.original: וַתִּהְיֶ֜ינָה מַחְלָ֣ה תִרְצָ֗ה וְחָגְלָ֧ה וּמִלְכָּ֛ה וְנֹעָ֖ה בְּנ֣וֹת צְלָפְחָ֑ד לִבְנֵ֥י דֹדֵיהֶ֖ן לְנָשִֽׁים׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tih·ye·nāh maḥ·lāh ṯir·ṣāh wə·ḥā·ḡə·lāh ū·mil·kāh wə·nō·‘āh bə·nō·wṯ ṣə·lā·p̄ə·ḥāḏ liḇ·nê ḏō·ḏê·hen lə·nā·šîm
verses.literal: Mahlah Tirzah Hoglah Milcah and Noah the daughters of Zelophehad were married to cousins on their father’s side
verses.literalPt: Pois Maalá, Tirza, Hogla, Milca e Noa, filhas de Zelofeade, se casaram com os filhos de seus tios.

verses.original: מִֽמִּשְׁפְּחֹ֛ת בְּנֵֽי־ מְנַשֶּׁ֥ה בֶן־ יוֹסֵ֖ף הָי֣וּ לְנָשִׁ֑ים וַתְּהִי֙ נַחֲלָתָ֔ן עַל־ מַטֵּ֖ה מִשְׁפַּ֥חַת אֲבִיהֶֽן׃
verses.transliteration: mim·miš·pə·ḥōṯ bə·nê- mə·naš·šeh ḇen- yō·w·sêp̄ hā·yū lə·nā·šîm wat·tə·hî na·ḥă·lā·ṯān ‘al- maṭ·ṭêh miš·pa·ḥaṯ ’ă·ḇî·hen
verses.literal: They married . . . within the clans of the descendants of Manasseh son of Joseph and their inheritance remained within the tribe of their father’s clan
verses.literalPt: E elas casaram-se nas famílias dos filhos de Manassés, filho de José; assim a sua herança ficou na tribo da família de seu pai.

verses.original: אֵ֣לֶּה הַמִּצְוֺ֞ת וְהַמִּשְׁפָּטִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה בְּיַד־ מֹשֶׁ֖ה אֶל־ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל בְּעַֽרְבֹ֣ת מוֹאָ֔ב עַ֖ל יַרְדֵּ֥ן יְרֵחֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ’êl·leh ham·miṣ·wōṯ wə·ham·miš·pā·ṭîm ’ă·šer ṣiw·wāh Yah·weh bə·yaḏ- mō·šeh ’el- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl bə·‘ar·ḇōṯ mō·w·’āḇ ‘al yar·dên yə·rê·ḥōw
verses.literal: These are the commandments and ordinances that the LORD gave the Israelites . . . through Moses . . . on the plains of Moab by the Jordan across from Jericho
verses.literalPt: Estes são os mandamentos e os juízos que mandou o SENHOR através de Moisés aos filhos de Israel nas campinas de Moabe, junto ao Jordão, na direção de Jericó.
